Follow-up to v0.1.79, from the same two joins.

## Server

### Fixed
- Blank decoy records are retired. The game's follow-up after a load finds a record by the player's last seen name, not by id, so a blank record carrying the same name as the player's real one won every time and bound the client to its inventory, whatever the id lookup had returned. Once a player has a record under a synthetic id, any other record with a blank id and the same name has its id and name retired so it can never match again; this runs at boot and before every swap.
- The v0.1.79 repair could not recognise a record the game had overwritten with both the blank id and the blank inventory id. With the decoys gone the overwritten inventory id is the player's own again, so the repair matches.
